# ankra_organisation_dns_record (Resource)

A DNS record in the organisation's own delegated zone (see `ankra_organisation_dns_zone`). The platform publishes it asynchronously: `state` moves from `pending` to `active`, or `failed` with `last_error`. The counterpart of `ankra org dns add|update|delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_organisation_dns_record" "logs" {
  name        = "logs"
  record_type = "CNAME"
  content     = "logs.eu-cluster.example.net"
  ttl         = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) What the record points at: an address for `A`/`AAAA`, a hostname for `CNAME`, text for `TXT`. Leading and trailing whitespace is refused, because the platform trims it.
- `name` (String) Label inside the organisation's zone, such as `logs` or `eu.logs`, in lower case. Changing it replaces the record.
- `record_type` (String) `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME` or `TXT`. Changing it replaces the record.

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds, 30 to 86400. Unset is Auto.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) Full name of the record: the label plus the organisation's zone.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the record.
- `last_error` (String) Why the last publication failed, when it did.
- `state` (String) Publication state: `pending`, `active` or `failed`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Organisation DNS records are imported by id.
terraform import ankra_organisation_dns_record.logs 0d3c2b1a-9e8f-4a7b-8c6d-5e4f3a2b1c0d
```
